notes.value: Table 1 entry 12, Table 2 entry 1, Scheme 2, and the two typical procedures describe the same optimized 1a/4a to 6aa sequence and are merged here.
The cyclization resin was washed successively with DMF, DMF/H2O (1:1), H2O, DMF, THF, and MeOH, then dried under high vacuum overnight.
Method A workup: filter and wash resin with EtOAc; wash filtrate twice with 0.5 N HCl; extract aqueous layer with EtOAc; dry combined extracts and evaporate.
The prose states that four to six equivalents of AlCl3 at 0.3-0.5 M gave the best results.

unresolved: The method-A procedure prints AlCl3 as 0.6 equiv but also 0.6 mmol for about 0.10 mmol maximum resin loading, which is internally inconsistent and may represent 6 equiv; the printed values are preserved.

The source reports i-Pr2NEt as 2 equiv in the adjacent prose and 8.0 equiv in the typical procedure without explicitly naming the reference basis for either value; both are retained without assigning a basis.
The approximately 100% resin-5aa yield is reported on a maximum-loading basis and is not treated as a chemically verified mass balance.
